content: माया [मा-यः बा˚ नेत्वम्] .²1 Deceit, fraud, trick, trickery; a device, an artifice; रथचर्यास्त्रमायाभिर्मोहयित्वा परंतप <ls>Mb. 7. 46. 24</ls>; यो मायां कुरुते मूढः प्राणत्यागे धनादिके <ls>Pt. 1. 359</ls>. .²2 Jugglery, witchercraft, enchantment, an illusion of magic; स्वप्नो नु माया नु मतिभ्रमो नु <ls>Ś. 6. 10</ls>; मायायोगविदां चैव न स्वयं कोपकारणात् <ls>Kau. A. 1. 19</ls>. .²3 (Hence) An unreal or illusory image, a phantom, illusion, unreal apparition; मायां मयोद्भाव्य परीक्षितोऽसि <ls>R. 2. 62</ls>; विकृतिः किं नु भवेदियं नु माया <ls>Ki. 13. 4</ls>; <ls>R. 12. 74</ls>; <ab>oft.</ab> as the first member of <ab>comp.</ab> in the sense of ‘false’, ‘phantom’, ‘illusory’; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} मायावचनम् false words; मायामृग <ab>&c.</ab> .²4 A political trick or artifice, diplomatic feat. .²5 (In Vedānta <ab>phil.</ab>) Unreality, the illusion by virtue of which one considers the unreal universe as really existent and as distinct from the Supreme Spirit; मायां तु प्रकृतिं विद्यान्मायिनं तु महेश्वरम् <ls>Śvet. Up.</ls> .²6 (In <ab>Sāṅ. phil.</ab>) The Pradhāna or Prakṛti. .²7 Wickedness. .²8 Pity, compassion. .²9 <ab>N.</ab> of the mother of Buddha. .²10 <ab>Ved.</ab> Extraordinary power, wisdom (प्रज्ञा). .²11 (With Śaivas) One of the four snares (पाश) which entangle the soul. .²12 <ab>N.</ab> of the city Gayā. .²13 <ab>N.</ab> of Lakṣmī. .²14 <ab>N.</ab> of Durgā; देवीं मायां तु श्रीकामः <ls>Bhāg. 2. 3. 3</ls>. .²15 Skill, art; दधारैको रणे राजन् वृषसेनोऽस्त्रमायया <ls>Mb. 7. 16. 1</ls>.
